name: Sector solution tabs (legacy content theme)
purpose: Sells sector-specific content bundles: a header pitch and CTA, then a pick-your-sector list that previews each bundle with an image.
description: Legacy content (yellow, hairline-framed) block used on /content. Header row: eyebrow chip, large serif H2 and a yellow pill button on the left, grey multi-paragraph copy bottom-aligned on the right. Below, a 5-column frame: a 2/5 vertical tab list (rows share the height; the active row shows its summary on a dotted texture) and a 3/5 image pane with a dark bottom fade and an outlined 'Learn more' button. <=767 the header stacks; <=479 the tabs become an accordion of serif heading rows each opening to its text and image.

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.
motion.note: Desktop/tablet: clicking a tab row cross-fades the image pane (.fade-pane opacity/visibility .3s ease) and the rows resize (transition all .2s). <=479 accordion: body grid-rows 0fr->1fr over 400ms ease with the #232011 open background (liveDetails, as on /content), closing in 100ms. Buttons have a .3s border-radius transition and colour hovers.
